recipes:

2. We can start making blue dye using lapis lazuli to have some initial supply. However, we also need to make sure we keep track of the lapis lazuli used for the lapis block.
3. Craft one blue dye using 1 piece of lapis lazuli.
4. Keep 8 pieces of the remaining lapis lazuli for making the lapis block, and discard or save the blue dye we just crafted.
5. Craft 9 pieces of lapis lazuli using the 8 pieces we kept and the 1 piece of lapis lazuli we just crafted.
6. Use these 9 pieces of lapis lazuli to craft a lapis block.

This sequence ensures that we make as much blue dye as possible to utilize our limited lapis lazuli resources efficiently while gathering enough lapis lazuli to craft the lapis block.
